title: RootHubPointers
description: Canonical machine-readable pointer registry. README.md + CLAUDE.md + AGENTS.md (only Markdown files surviving at repo root per user directive 2026-05-13) include a section that references this file. Agents read this JSON to discover canonical entry points; humans read the README/CLAUDE/AGENTS summaries that mirror this.

user_directives_2026_05_13: the only thing that we should maintain is a README.md
that should utilize machine readable pointers to relevant files
Heavy diet. Make sure everything has a purpose.
_meta.purpose: Canonical machine-readable pointer registry. README.md + CLAUDE.md + AGENTS.md (only Markdown files surviving at repo root per user directive 2026-05-13) include a section that references this file.

_retired_constitutional_authority.retirement_note: Per user directive 2026-05-13 'i dont think constitution is necessary'. Strike executed 2026-05-15. Content redistributed to 4 machine-readable successor specs (see decision_principles, forbidden_operations, decision_rights, governance_amendment entry_points below). docs/CONSTITUTION.md deleted; crates/oya-check-constitution-cite deleted; oya-dev-cli constitution-cite gate removed. Per-file citation sweep tracked as follow-up.

decision_principles.purpose: 10 normative do-rules every contributor and agent follows. Each principle declares enforcement mode (mechanical / cultural / mechanical-stub / deferred) and cites the lanes enforcing it. Successor to docs/CONSTITUTION.md §Decision-principles — Do.

forbidden_operations.purpose: 10 prohibitions with severity (critical / high / medium) + enforcement mode + lane citations. Successor to docs/CONSTITUTION.md §Prohibitions — Avoid. Companion to master-plan-sequencing.json forbidden_primitives (lower-level: tooling vs. doctrine).

decision_rights.purpose: 12-class decision-rights table (owner + escalation per class). Successor to docs/CONSTITUTION.md §Decision-rights. Per-team RACI detail still in docs/RACI-OWNERSHIP.md.

governance_amendment.purpose: 6-step amendment procedure for the 4-file doctrinal substrate. Declares EVT-DOCTRINE-AMENDED audit-chain event. Successor to docs/CONSTITUTION.md §Amendments.

agent_operating_contract.purpose: Canonical agent operating contract (done-definition checklist, Oya VCS state transitions, multispectrum evidence, legacy-tool compatibility notes).

doc_catalog.purpose: Per-doc lifecycle protocol. Every canonical doc has class + owner + length cap + 'Does NOT cover' clause.

active_artifact_contract.purpose: v3.0.0 9-capability contract per ADR-0069. Every machine-readable artifact declares enforcement+verification+validation+autogen+selfheal+selfupdate+selfmaintain+telemetry+provenance.

knowledge_graph_semantic.migration_phase: complete (per Palantir 3-layer split commit 0806f91; supersedes knowledge-graph-catalog.json deleted in same commit)
knowledge_graph_semantic.purpose: SEMANTIC layer: 24 node types + 18 edge types + 14 invariants + 5 read-side queries. Static structure of the knowledge graph.

knowledge_graph_kinetic.purpose: KINETIC layer: 14 action types + 4 workflows. Write-side mutations with audit topic + idempotency + lock pattern.

knowledge_graph_dynamic.purpose: DYNAMIC layer: 9 live state sources + OTel telemetry pointers. Real-time graph state.

artifact_capabilities_registry.migration_phase: complete (10 baseline rows; per-artifact rows added incrementally)
artifact_capabilities_registry.purpose: Control plane: one row per machine-readable artifact + artifact_profile + capability_overrides.

reusable_building_blocks_registry.purpose: DRY enforcement. Single canonical home per block + consumer_refs + consumer_selectors.

plan_schema.purpose: JSON Schema for ralplan consensus plans. Markdown plans are projections (being retired).

master_plan_sequencing.purpose: Forbidden-primitive list (git/gh) + Oya VCS protocol + ledger-required-fields + execution sequence.

evidence_taxonomy.purpose: 8 evidence classes + freshness rule + minimum_completion_set for ledger rows.

stop_conditions.purpose: SC-01..SC-09 stop conditions for autonomous master-plan loop.

final_report_schema.purpose: JSON Schema for MPR-... final autonomous master-plan completion reports.

markdown_retirement_policy.purpose: Migration policy per user 'we don't need markdown' directive. 8 phases; ~250 files to retire by 2026-08-31.

markdown_retirement_ledger.migration_phase: complete (seed; per-row migration tracked over time)
markdown_retirement_ledger.purpose: Per-file rows tracking each Markdown retirement event (source_md_path / target_json_path / status / migration_date).

gitops_vcs_replacement.purpose: M-CC-P00 Oya VCS replacement contract: semantic symbol locks + ChangeBundle/GitOps promotion/controller integration for CI/CD-safe agent work.

test_standard.purpose: Machine-readable unit/integration/e2e/property/fuzz test standard enforced by GitOps VCS admission and CI/CD gates.

test_suite_registry.purpose: Registry-driven polyglot test commands and evidence outputs by language/surface.

oyatie_doctrine.purpose: Workspace-wide doctrine. Principles P0..P8 apply to every documentation / file / workflow / lane / ADR / spec / registry / code change. P0 (agentic-primary) elevates agent consumption above human; P1 (machine-optimized); P2 (programmatic-where-possible); P3 (deterministic-where-it-matters); P4 (enforce-in-every-thing); P5 (iterate-until-consensus); P6 (no-silent-regression); P7 (Bominal-inheritance-precedence); P8 (canonical-base + localization-pack). Cited by docs/AGENTS.md and every ADR.

multispectrum_review.purpose: Multispectrum review bar — 12 facets (F1..F13 minus F12-reserved) + 2 meta-facets (M1, M2). v2.0.0 added F8 performance + F9 compliance + meta-facets + enforcement_scopes (agentic_flow + dev_flow) + consensus_debate_protocol + alias_map. v2.1.0 added F10 reversibility + F11 observability + F13 migration + deterministic_layer_principle + scorecard_schema. Enforced mechanically by oya-check-dependency-seam sub-checks (multispectrum-evidence-attached, fixture-pair-coverage, change-class-declared) and by SessionStart hook reminder.

pre_pr_multispectrum_checklist.human_companion_path_retired: /templates/checklists/pre-pr-multispectrum.md (RETIRED 2026-05-14 — JSON template is the canonical form; markdown was duplicative human gateway)
pre_pr_multispectrum_checklist.purpose: Machine-readable pre-PR gate template. Every changeset copies + fills evidence per facet; the seam lane refuses missing/incomplete sections. Iterative fix-and-review loop in /specs/cross-cutting/iterative-fix-loop.json.

iterative_fix_loop.purpose: Loop state machine for find→fix→re-review until all facets green. Bounded by iteration_budget. Escalates to human when budget exhausted.

fixuptask_registry.purpose: Append-only JSONL stream of bounded FixupTasks. One JSON record per line: {id, title, priority, status, source_session, source_change_id, named_in, created_at, blocker_for?}. Consumed by lane sub-checks + dashboards.

audit_chain.migration_phase: scaffold (F-EVIDENCE-AUDIT-CHAIN-WIRE pending for ADR-0069 cryptographic-immutability integration)
audit_chain.purpose: Append-only JSONL stream of changeset evidence emissions, lane runs, spec-version bumps, ADR acceptances, IP status flips, seam audit baselines. Schema: {event_type, change_id?, session_id, timestamp_unix, payload}.

by_kind.spec: Schema or canonical-truth definition. Read by validators + agents.
by_kind.registry: Data plane with rows. Validators check row conformance to schema.
by_kind.policy: Decision rule (e.g., migration policy, retention policy).

agent_quick_start_protocol.step_2_context_recall: Prefer Oya VCS / Foundry-native context once available; legacy icm recall-context is compatibility/provenance only and is never promotion authority.
agent_quick_start_protocol.step_3_oya_vcs_state_transition: Every agent→repo state transition uses Oya VCS claim → work → verify → done → promote. Legacy grit/icm/rtk/vox/omx/omc surfaces are read/provenance/compatibility only during cutover.
agent_quick_start_protocol.step_4_active_artifact_contract: Every new artifact under applicable_paths_glob conforms to active-artifact-contract v3.0.0 + registers a row in artifact-capabilities-registry.
agent_quick_start_protocol.step_5_multispectrum_evidence: Every ChangeBundle promotion carries multispectrum evidence per /specs/cross-cutting/multispectrum-review.json; missing or incomplete evidence blocks Oya VCS admission.
agent_quick_start_protocol.step_6_gitops_vcs_replacement: Before broad multi-agent fan-out, honor /specs/cross-cutting/gitops-vcs-replacement.json: Oya VCS owns claim coverage, ChangeBundle closeout, review/fix loops, controller rebase/merge queue, and GitOps promotion.
